title: The Hallway
description: As you continue wandering down the hallway, you notice banners, pictures, and other fine decorations adorning the walls all along this passage.  It seems very different from the dismal passage where you entered.
npcs: A finely crafted newbie mace is waiting for a worthy owner. ..It has a soft glowing aura!
A set of nifty sleeves is here.
A pair of neat looking leggings are here.
items: A little pile of gold coins is lying here.
A bright green newbie vest is lying here looking for a body to hug.
